start: Start / Resume screen of a routine the member has done before with weights

steps.action: Open the Start screen of the routine
user_sees: One numbered row per exercise: name, its Target line, and an orange line with the kilos to beat and the % on last time
must_not: A row with no Target line

steps.action: Tap a row that has a kg to beat
user_sees: The arrow turns down and each set's weight x reps shows under it
must_not: Set lines that do not add up to the kilos to beat

user_sees: The set lines hide, arrow back to the right
must_not: The workout starting from this tap

start: Start screen, a routine with a body-weight move (no kilos, for example Pull-up)

user_sees: Its Target line and the reps to beat instead of kilos
Each set's reps under it (screen reader hint 'Shows the reps of each set')
must_not: Weights shown for a body-weight move

start: Start screen, an exercise done for the first time (or a hold, or an easy week)

user_sees: Only the name and the Target line; no arrow
must_not: A kilos-to-beat line built from no data

user_sees: Nothing opens (the row is not a button)
must_not: An empty list of sets opening

start: Start screen, the member changed how the weight is counted since last time

user_sees: A reason line: 'You changed how this weight is counted, so there is no previous total to beat.'
must_not: A kilos-to-beat figure comparing two different counting ways

start: Start screen opened again after finishing the routine once more

steps.action: Finish the routine with new sets, then open its Start screen again
user_sees: The kilos to beat now come from the newest workout
must_not: The figures still from the workout before
The row left open from last time

steps.action: Discard (delete) that newest workout and open the Start screen
user_sees: The kilos to beat go back to the workout before it
must_not: A deleted workout still used as the one to beat

user_sees: Figures come only from the member's own workouts on this phone
must_not: Another member's or the gym's numbers shown
Body weight shown in the reason lines
